tour.title: What Tasks Hub is
tour.description: Start with the README and agent notes: a personal task/project manager (Clare DeMind) — Vite + TypeScript vanilla DOM, mock API locally, Netlify Functions + Blobs in production.

tour.title: How the SPA boots
tour.description: index.html mounts #app with data-hub=tasks and loads src/app/main.ts, which builds the shell and starts the session.

tour.title: Sign-in gate
tour.description: The passphrase gate (tasks-hub-local) blocks every /api/* call until the session cookie is valid. Production hashes the secret; the mock API checks the literal.

tour.title: Client store and API
tour.description: Views talk to a typed client and an in-memory store. Locally Vite mounts scripts/mock-api.ts; production hits Netlify Functions.

tour.title: Task model and queries
tour.description: Zod schemas define persisted records. Domain queries power Board, Today, Backlog, and calendar without remounting on every edit.

tour.title: Board and calendar surfaces
tour.description: The home Board and Calendar update in place on add/delete. Project-scope filters and hub-pills stay on the current view.

tour.title: Clare brain dumps
tour.description: A dump goes through domain heuristics, optional Haiku (claude-haiku-4-5), and Life Hub context stripping, then confirm cards on the Clare desk.

tour.title: Network Look with judgment
tour.description: Stress flags are rule-based plus an optional Haiku intuitive scan. The scheduled Function only runs at selected Australia/Sydney hours and never rewrites tasks.

tour.title: Maps, Universe, and pipes
tour.description: MindWorks maps, the all-projects Universe canvas, and blocker pipe chains sit on domain layout math plus vanilla-DOM views.

tour.title: Production API and seed
tour.description: Netlify Functions persist collections in Blobs. Seed from fixtures (Programs from competitions.json only — never Notion). GitHub Actions deploys Pages and Functions.
